title: OS Version Info for Android
meta_description: Quickly check OS (Operating System) version information for your Android device.
full_description: Easiest way to check and know the version information of your Android device.This OS Version Info app allows you to check which version of Android is running on your smartphone.No need to go into the settings and find the version details, just open this OS Version Info app and see the flavor of Android which powers your smartphone.Along with Android flavor, app shows following details of Android Operating System version:1. Version Code2. Version Number3. Android Version Code Name4. Incremental5. Android Release Number6. Android SDK Version Number7. Logo for Android VersionJust for information following are the versions of Android:1. Apple Pie (1.0)2. Banana Bread (1.1)3. Cup Cake (1.5)4. Donut (1.6)5. Eclair (2.0 - 2.1)6. Froyo (2.2 - 2.2.3)7. Ginger Bread (2.3 - 2.3.7)8. Honeycomb (3.0 - 3.2.6)9. Ice Cream Sandwich (4.0 - 4.0.6)10. Jelly Bean (4.1 - 4.3.1)11. KitKat (4.4 - 4.4.4)12. Lollipop (5.0 - 5.1.1)13. Marshmallow (6.0 - 6.0.1)14. Nougat (7.0 - 7.1.2)15. Oreo (8.0 - 8.1.1)16. Pie  - Android Pie (9.0)Be smart and know what version of Android is running on your Smartphone, it's too easy with this app.People who is buying any new Android Smartphone, should consider OS Version Info of the device and also for check availability of OTA update from manufacturer for future Android Releases Support to make most out of your money and to enjoy more new features in future from latest Android versions.Share it if you like it.Disclaimer: Android and its all the images are owned by Google and this app is not affiliated with it.
